items.text: All four pieces are the saxophonist's own compositions, and the CD reissue adds an alternate take of one of them.
items.why: Track listing: 'All compositions by Sam Rivers', four titles plus '"Mellifluous Cacophony" [Alternate Take] ... Bonus track on CD reissue'; Lead: 'The CD reissue contains an alternate take as a bonus track'. Accurate but would fit most Blue Note reissues of a leader's originals; weak as a hook.

items.why: Track listing: '"Mellifluous Cacophony" [Alternate Take] - 9:04 Bonus track on CD reissue'. Title matches. Says nothing about what to listen for, and repeats the hook.

missed: The Lead's basic framing is gone: this is Rivers's second album (his second for Blue Note) and it is avant-garde jazz; the Reception quote says he 'fully embraced the avant-garde' but kept it approachable for hard bop listeners, which tells a newcomer what to expect. The pieces are also long (about 9 to 12 minutes each).
